title: KaruppaSamy Kuthagaitharar
desc: Karuppusamy, a carefree man, works as a contractor for cycle stands. However, his life changes when he falls in love with a young woman, Raasathi.

title: Indru Nee Naalai Naan
desc: Pazhaniappa, an innocent villager, finds a beautiful bride for his brother, Marudhu, an active politician. Tragedy sets in after Marudhu becomes a drunkard and dies because he loses in the elections.

title: Thenkasi Pattanam
desc: Kannan and Dass become feared rowdies under the guidance of their godfather. But two women, Meenakshi and Sangeetha bring forth a whirlwind of events in their lives.

title: Kizhakku Cheemayile
desc: A brother shares a close bond with his sister and is ecstatic to see her get married. However, problems arise when his new brother-in-law disapproves of the sibling relationship.

title: Sonthakkaran
desc: After sending an evil man to prison for rape and murder, an honest cop loses his job on false allegations. Soon, his old nemesis returns for revenge.

title: Thayi Pongal
desc: Janaki loses her husband early in her life and is left with a girl child. Without any support, she experiences tough situations involving lecherous men. She meets Vairam who supports her.

title: Thathi Thavuthu Manasu
desc: Three rural girls visit Chennai for a wedding, excited for city life. However, their joy ends when thieves steal their money, leaving them stuck far from home.

title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: Maha Nadigan
desc: Sathya, a junior artiste, manages to secure a chance to play a hero in a movie. As his fame gradually increases, he decides to enter politics.
